# March 31, 1950 data
max_1950 = 275000  # millions of dollars
subject_1950 = 255013  # millions of dollars

# Calculate arithmetic mean
mean_utilization = (utilization_1950 + utilization_1955) / 2

print(f"Arithmetic mean: {mean_utilization:.4f}%")
print(f"Arithmetic mean (rounded to 2 decimal places): {mean_utilization:.2f}")
